sources.title: Industrial Visual Anomaly Synthesis: A Deployment-Oriented Survey
sources.verification_scope: Targeted_full_text_review_of_author_uploaded_CC_BY_open_access_copy_sections_I_II_III_VII_VIII; publisher_landing_page_not_accessible_in_browser; no independent reviewer or method execution
sources.description_ko: Zhang et al., IEEE Access 14 (2026), 98025-98045, DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2026.3706950. 전문은 training-demand/input-output interface taxonomy, official-code links, resource/lifecycle/cost and failure guidance, separate intrinsic/downstream/deployment evidence, and ASBench plus paper-reported benchmark evidence. It explicitly states downstream gain does not establish process-faithful defect generation; proposes future process-aware priors using material/geometry/manufacturing conditions, and recommends provenance of generator version/conditions/post-processing. These themes cannot independently ground novelty. In the inspected copy, no release-level third-party execution result, legal rights-chain audit, or governing-equation/solver measurement was identified; this is bounded to reviewed article sections and is not proof such evidence is absent elsewhere. Publisher final landing/errata verification remains pending. Details: runs/wp0/s73_fulltext_scope_audit_20261010.md.

sources.title: SMPL: Simulated Industrial Manufacturing and Process Control Learning Environments (NeurIPS 2022 Datasets and Benchmarks Track)
sources.description_ko: NeurIPS 2022 Datasets and Benchmarks Track. BeerFMTEnv, ReactorEnv, AtropineEnv, PenSimEnv, mAbEnv 등 5개 산업 제조/공정제어 시뮬레이션 환경이 공개 동역학 모델에 기반한다고 보고하며 RL benchmark를 포함한다. 시뮬레이터 활용과 실공정 실증은 분리한다.

sources.title: Mohan-Zhang-u/smpl official SMPL simulator repository and setup documentation
sources.description_ko: SMPL repository redirects to Mohan-Zhang-u/smpl, public MIT. README gives pip install but states PenSimEnv additionally needs separately built fastodeint and PenSimPy; Linux setup includes native libomp-dev/libboost-all-dev and submodule/dependency builds. No pinned environment or execution performed.

sources.title: CAD-Coder: Text-to-CAD Generation with Chain-of-Thought and Geometric Reward (NeurIPS 2025 Main Conference)
sources.description_ko: NeurIPS 2025 main conference. Generates CadQuery scripts from text, uses Chamfer/geometric and format rewards, and introduces 110K text-CadQuery-3D model triplets plus 1.5K CoT samples. CAD geometry quality does not establish process physics or production manufacturability.

sources.title: gudo7208/CAD-Coder official code repository
sources.description_ko: Author repository links paper, dataset and model; gives Transformers inference, Python 3.10 Conda setup, optional CadQuery execution and Apache 2.0 statement. It supplies inference.py and batch inference, but README does not fix model revision, hardware memory budget or industrial engineering validation.

sources.title: gudo7208/CAD-Coder dataset card and public dataset viewer
sources.description_ko: Linked Hugging Face dataset shows Apache-2.0 and train/validation/test dataset viewer, with 233K train rows displayed. This differs in unit/count from paper's 110K text-CadQuery-model triplets; row-level schema, actual file hashes and source Text2CAD/derived rights require audit.

sources.title: gudo7208/CAD-Coder model card and checkpoint metadata
sources.description_ko: Model card shows public Apache-2.0 statement tied to Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct terms, 8B parameters, BF16 and a Transformers loading example; paper-trained model uses 8x A800 80GB. Current task host GPU is 16GB with competing usage, so direct BF16 execution is not established; no weight download/run.

sources.title: A Survey on Industrial Anomaly Synthesis — CityU Scholars publication record
sources.description_ko: TMLR 2026-August 동료심사 출판, 2026-08-27 온라인 공개로 기재. 산업 이상합성 4분류, 데이터·benchmark·metric, multimodal과 입력·출력·제어·비용·downstream·실무비교를 확인. 직접 실행/물리검증은 서지 초록만으로 판정하지 않음.

sources.title: A Survey on Industrial Anomaly Synthesis — OpenReview forum record
sources.description_ko: 공식 OpenReview forum 링크를 확인했으나 현재 browser challenge로 전문/메타데이터 직접 조회는 막힘. 동일 서지정보와 게재월은 CityUHK Scholars 레코드 S98로 교차 확인.

sources.title: CReFT-CAD: NeurIPS 2025 main-conference abstract and proceedings record
sources.description_ko: NeurIPS 2025 main paper. CReFT-CAD orthographic-projection reasoning and TriView2CAD open benchmark; paper links official author code. Reports 200,000 synthetic and 3,000 real-world projection samples with six modalities.

sources.title: CReFT-CAD official NeurIPS proceedings full paper
sources.description_ko: NeurIPS proceedings full paper checked: constraint-driven 15-parameter TriView2CAD generation, 200k synthetic + 3k real projections, geometric consistency/STEP-BRep output, accuracy results; training used one server with 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs; no factory product/plant validation established in reviewed scope.

sources.title: KeNiu042/CReFT-CAD official author GitHub repository and README
sources.description_ko: Official repo links TriView2CAD dataset and pretrained model on ModelScope. README contains a stale “will be released upon paper acceptance” statement beside those active links, no explicit license line was found in inspected README/repo listing; dataset/model terms and completeness remain unresolved.

sources.title: KeNiu042/CReFT-CAD pinned dependency requirements listing
sources.description_ko: Author requirements file has 284 pinned lines and contains a flash_attn wheel dependency via file:// absolute path under /home/chenzhuofan/...; this prevents portable fresh-environment installation as written unless separately replaced.

sources.title: zhuofanChen/TriView2CAD dataset and pretrained model links (ModelScope)
sources.description_ko: Repository README links this dataset landing page; browser returned no readable metadata, so bulk access, revision/checksum, license and item-level rights are not confirmed. The linked pretrained model landing page is https://www.modelscope.cn/models/zhuofanChen/CReFT-CAD and similarly needs direct host-side audit.

sources.title: LithoSim NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks official proceedings abstract
sources.description_ko: NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track. Reports over 4 million high-resolution input-output pairs with physical correspondence, optical source distributions, metal/via topologies, OPC variants, and process windows; links code, data and pretrained models.

sources.title: LithoSim official project quickstart
sources.description_ko: Quickstart specifies Python 3.9+, at least 60GB RAM (80GB recommended), SSD, dataset extraction/path preparation, repository install and train/eval commands; identifies ID/OOD splits and IoU/Dice, accuracy, MSE, EPE metrics.

sources.title: dw-hongquan/LithoSim official code repository
sources.description_ko: Public repository presents Apache-2.0 license and was archived by owner on 2026-07-01; top-level includes configs, source, tools, requirements/environment files. Archive is read-only; runtime and current compatibility not independently tested.

sources.title: LithoSim author project page and dataset information
sources.description_ko: Project page states code Apache-2.0 and dataset CC BY-NC 4.0; data information specifies separate 70/10/20 splits per mask category and reserved OOD tests including M3/via and unconventional illumination. This conflicts with Hugging Face AFL-3.0 tags recorded in S109-S110.

sources.title: grandiflorum/LithoSim dataset card
sources.description_ko: Official proceedings-linked dataset host reports AFL-3.0, approximately 135GB and about 4.09 million samples. Conflicts with author project page CC BY-NC 4.0; no bulk download.

sources.title: grandiflorum/LithoSim pretrained model card
sources.description_ko: Official proceedings-linked model host reports AFL-3.0, image-to-image; README content is empty and no hosted inference provider is listed. Revision, weights, runtime and paper-page licensing consistency require follow-up.

sources.title: LithoSim full paper hosted by author-affiliated CUHK lab
sources.description_ko: Full paper results include MSE, pixel accuracy, IoU, max/average edge-placement error and turnaround time; it compares six baselines across four categories. The benchmark is grounded in lithography simulation outputs; factory-wafer metrology/production qualification is not established by reported benchmark results.

sources.title: LIPS NeurIPS 2022 Datasets and Benchmarks proceedings
sources.description_ko: Top-AI benchmark for data-driven augmentation of industrial physical simulators. Defines accuracy/ML, OOD generalization, industrial readiness and physical-constraint categories and studies power-grid and pneumatic use cases.

sources.title: IRT-SystemX/LIPS official repository
sources.description_ko: Public benchmark code under MPL-2.0. README documents pip/source install, solver-generated synthetic data path, train/evaluate APIs, benchmark configs and CPU-only example. Dataset/source rights and clean-install/runtime remain unverified.

sources.title: LIPS full paper and supplement
sources.description_ko: Full paper and supplement describe power-grid and pneumatic cases, physical-law compliance, OOD/generalization, quality/speed/readiness criteria and Codabench submission. Benchmark results are not blanket production qualification.

sources.title: ML4PhySim power-grid challenge official evaluation criteria
sources.description_ko: Official challenge documentation assesses prediction and physical compliance, including local/global energy conservation. Benchmark results do not establish a manufacturing profile or production deployment.

sources.title: PyPI lightsim2grid 0.8.1 release files and Python/platform wheel tags
sources.description_ko: LIPS 0.2.7 setup pins lightsim2grid==0.8.1. Official PyPI file listing has no CPython 3.11 Windows x64 wheel; source build or supported Python/platform runner may be required. This is a local environment blocker, not proof the artifact is universally unrunnable.

sources.title: EngiBench: A Framework for Data-Driven Engineering Design Research — NeurIPS 2025 proceedings
sources.description_ko: NeurIPS D&B paper introduces EngiBench datasets and EngiOpt generative/surrogate algorithms, simulator-based design evaluation, feasibility checking and experiment workflows.

sources.title: IDEALLab/EngiBench official repository and documentation
sources.description_ko: Install path is `pip install engibench`; some problems require Docker/Singularity or native dependencies. API exposes datasets, conditions, constraints, simulation and optimization. Code is GPLv3; datasets are CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0, restricting commercial reuse absent separate permission.

sources.title: IDEALLab/EngiOpt official companion repository
sources.description_ko: Official examples document generator training, public Hugging Face checkpoints and a shared evaluator. Evaluation records checkpoint hash, repository/revision, EngiOpt/EngiBench versions and a dataset-pinned spec. The README states PyPI EngiBench 0.2.0 has stale v0 data for photonics2d/thermoelastic2d, requiring source install for its frozen specs.

sources.title: EngiOpt official leaderboard verification protocol
sources.description_ko: Rows remain unverified until an independent runner fetches the recorded checkpoint revision, checks hash, reconstructs the model and rescores. Required seeds and versioned eval specs address cherry-picking; copy/novelty and condition-sensitivity diagnostics address metric gaming. External submission currently needs board write access; public unauthenticated upload is not yet self-service.

sources.title: RealPDEBench: A Benchmark for Complex Physical Systems with Real-World Data — ICLR 2026
sources.description_ko: ICLR 2026 benchmark with paired real measurements and numerical simulations, five datasets, three tasks, nine metrics and ten baselines; evaluates sim-to-real forecasting.

sources.title: RealPDEBench official installation and experiment guide
sources.description_ko: Official docs require Python >=3.10 and document pip source install, metadata-only and selected-shard downloads, real/numerical training and checkpoint evaluation. Full use-case data require large Arrow downloads; credentials/network may be needed.

sources.title: RealPDEBench official paired-data inventory and size documentation
sources.description_ko: Five paired scenarios (cylinder, controlled cylinder, FSI, foil, combustion); per-scenario memory estimates range 94.73–335.64 GB. Real measured and matched simulated trajectories are paired by configuration, but initial frames are not necessarily aligned; real measurements may omit modalities available in simulations.

sources.title: AI4Science-WestlakeU/RealPDEBench official repository README and license
sources.description_ko: Official repo documents all 10 baseline families, model checkpoints for scenarios and training paradigms, plus dependencies on DPOT base weights for selected model. Repository LICENSE is CC BY-NC 4.0 (noncommercial); production/commercial clearance is not established.

sources.title: AI4Science-WestlakeU/RealPDEBench Hugging Face dataset card
sources.description_ko: Linked dataset card reports CC-BY-NC-4.0. The hosted row viewer reports a DatasetGenerationError/CastError; this does not establish that direct file downloads fail, but indicates a broken inspection path.

sources.title: AI4Science-WestlakeU/RealPDEBench-models Hugging Face model card
sources.description_ko: Linked checkpoints are listed under CC BY 4.0 with downloadable model files; no hosted inference provider is listed. DPOT backbone weights are separate and not included, with separate source/terms to audit.

sources.title: IDEALLab/beams_2d_50_100_v0 dataset card and downloaded snapshot
sources.description_ko: EngiBench D09 smoke test downloaded public train/val/test parquet; local Hugging Face cache pinned main snapshot ccb64d4f09cf66a5ed9ba2081438d695b9e2438d (train 92,921,370 bytes, val 17,753,791, test 5,905,138). Dataset declares CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0; valid for noncommercial research, not commercial-use clearance.

sources.title: Chip Placement with Diffusion Models (ICML 2025, PMLR 267)
sources.description_ko: ICML 2025 논문. 확산모델 macro placement를 위해 synthetic dataset을 생성하고 unseen realistic circuit benchmark로 zero-shot transfer를 평가한다고 보고한다.

sources.title: vint-1/chipdiffusion official author repository
sources.description_ko: data-gen scripts, training/evaluation code, GPU setup and Google Drive large-v2 checkpoint link are public. Repository page showed no license metadata or LICENSE file; checkpoint revision/hash and Google Drive terms not verified.

sources.title: Atlas3D: Physically Constrained Self-Supporting Text-to-3D for Simulation and Fabrication (NeurIPS 2024)
sources.description_ko: NeurIPS 2024 main-conference paper describing differentiable simulation-based stability loss under gravity/contact/friction and reporting simulation plus real-world 3D-print validation. This is self-supporting object fabrication, not production-process qualification.

sources.title: yunuoch/Atlas3D official author repository
sources.description_ko: Public repository labels code Apache-2.0. README links pretrained coarse-stage files, but requires Ubuntu 20.04/Python 3.9/PyTorch CUDA and a custom Warp build; checkpoint/data rights, revisions, third-party base model and complete deployment terms remain unverified.

sources.title: LithoGRPO: Fast Inverse Lithography via GRPO Reinforced Flow Matching — ICML 2026
sources.verification_scope: official_PMLR_ICML_2026_metadata_abstract_and_software_link_reviewed; full text not yet independently coded
sources.description_ko: ICML 2026 semiconductor inverse-lithography method combining flow matching and GRPO with physics-based ILT reward; reports over 130x faster shot counting while preserving ranking in its paper setting. Public author repository currently releases only the shot-counting component; core flow-matching training, checkpoints, physics reward/simulator, datasets and end-to-end inference are marked TODO.

sources.title: laiyao1/LithoGRPO official author repository at commit f694498f1523efb89381fd9fb8984247f166095e
sources.description_ko: Pinned commit f694498f1523efb89381fd9fb8984247f166095e. Repository code is MIT; current release lists only FastShotCounter and adabox reference, while flow-matching prior, GRPO fine-tuning, physics-based ILT reward/simulator, end-to-end inference, datasets/evaluation scripts are not yet released. Model badge links to a Hugging Face path but checkpoint availability/revision/license were not verified.

sources.title: IMDD-1M author project page

sources.description_ko: 고정 commit에서 소스 218개 파일, 모델 weight/checkpoint 없음, README의 yourusername 경로 및 익명 제출 placeholder, LICENSE의 <Your Name> 표기 확인. README는 model weights/checkpoints/output의 학술·교육 용도만 허용하고 상업·내부 산업 배포는 prior written permission이 필요하다고 명시.

sources.title: IMDD dataset repository linked from the author project page
sources.description_ko: 저자 project page가 dataset 링크로 연결하는 저장소. README는 도메인별 Google Drive 다운로드 경로 및 CC BY 4.0을 주장하지만 개별 원천 dataset/enterprise data의 재배포·상업 권리와 실제 1.24M 전체 접근 가능성은 확인되지 않음.

sources.title: DefectFill CVPR 2025 official proceedings record

sources.title: DefectFill author-linked arXiv full-text record
sources.description_ko: DefectFill 서지·초록 보조 자료. 비공식 구현은 공식 저자 release로 간주하지 않음.

sources.title: LithoBench NeurIPS 2023 Datasets and Benchmarks proceedings
sources.description_ko: NeurIPS 2023 D&B 논문. 120k+ lithography tiles; 실제 회로에서 crop 또는 testcase topology 기반 합성, lithography-model/ILT ground truth를 보고.

sources.title: shelljane/lithobench official repository README and license
sources.description_ko: 공식 저장소는 MIT code, Python 3.8/PyTorch 1.10 환경, Google Drive data/model을 안내. 자산을 내려받거나 실행하지 않았으며 회로·benchmark 데이터 권리는 별도.

sources.title: TopoGaussian ICLR 2025 official proceedings record
sources.description_ko: ICLR 2025 연구. differentiable particle simulator로 물체 내부 topology를 추론하며 synthetic dataset 및 3D-printed prototypes를 보고; generative manufacturing dataset method와 구분.

sources.title: TopoGaussian author project page
sources.description_ko: 저자 project page가 ICLR 논문 및 code 자원으로 연결. 저장소 revision, requirements, weights, license 및 run은 후속 audit 필요.

sources.title: FuncGenFoil NeurIPS 2025 official proceedings record and paper
sources.description_ko: NeurIPS 2025 main paper. airfoil function-space generation/flow matching, AF-200K label/diversity results, aerodynamic simulation evidence; directly relevant engineered geometry, not process-parameter/metrology validation.

sources.title: FuncGenFoil author preprint record
sources.description_ko: 저자 preprint. abstract/source states code will be released; this does not establish an available public code release at audit time.

sources.title: Photolithography Overlay Map Generation with Implicit Knowledge Distillation Diffusion Transformer (ICCV 2025 official paper)
sources.description_ko: ICCV 2025 논문. 저자들은 MPOM 실세계 반도체 산업 데이터, overlay map, equipment log, equipment/scanner/reticle IDs와 152GB 규모를 보고하며 FID/IS/sFID/Precision-Recall을 평가 지표로 사용한다. 보고된 generative quality는 독립 물리 검증이나 field qualification과 동일하지 않다.

sources.title: IKDDiT MPOM data README and downloader script
sources.description_ko: 저장소 데이터 README는 overlay image, equipment logs, equipment ID 및 실제 장비 데이터로 설명. 연결된 download_mpom.sh는 다운로드 URL을 http://example.com/mpom.zip로 설정하고 “real link”로 대체하라는 placeholder 주석을 포함한다. 따라서 이 스크립트로 논문 MPOM을 얻는다고 확인할 수 없다. 파일/데이터 권리와 download hash 미확인.

sources.title: IKDDiT author project page

sources.title: Towards Sim-to-Real Industrial Parts Classification With Synthetic Dataset (official CVF Open Access record)
sources.description_ko: CVPR 2023 Workshop on Vision-Based Industrial Inspection 논문 공식 CVF 메타데이터/초록. SIP-17 synthetic industrial parts dataset 및 5개 모델 synthetic-only training, 566 real industrial images evaluation을 저자 보고로 확인. Full PDF retrieval returned 403 in this pass; workshop paper is outside CVPR main-conference denominator.

sources.title: BilalTalha/SIP-17 official repository README and repository license
sources.description_ko: 저자 저장소 README·파일 목록·CC0-1.0 표시 점검. 저장소가 분류 code, 17 objects/33,000 synthetic images/566 industrial real images, ResNet 등 학습·평가 명령을 설명하고 생성 파이프라인은 ICRA 2025 후속 SynMfg 저장소로 안내함. README의 CC0 표시는 Kaggle 데이터의 출처별 권리까지 자동 포괄하지 않음.

sources.title: SIP-17 dataset distribution page on Kaggle
sources.description_ko: 저장소가 연결한 Kaggle 데이터 배포 페이지를 열었으나 본 감사에서는 공개 페이지 본문/라이선스/데이터 파일 목록을 확인하지 못함. 데이터 다운로드·재배포·상업권을 검증하지 않았음.

sources.title: ScienceDirect publisher record: Synthetic data generation in manufacturing review
sources.description_ko: Procedia CIRP vol.139 (2026), pp.440-445, DOI 10.1016/j.procir.2025.08.199 및 abstract scope를 대조했다.

sources.title: DTU Research Database author publication record: manufacturing synthetic-data review
sources.description_ko: DTU 기관 연구자 프로필의 publication listing으로 Sara Shafiee 단독 저자 표기를 교차 확인했다.

sources.title: ScienceDirect publisher record: Physics-informed machine learning across manufacturing processes
sources.description_ko: JMS 2026, 85권, 72-95쪽, DOI 10.1016/j.jmsy.2026.01.002. 출판사 검색 색인 발췌는 주요 학술 데이터베이스와 PIML 용어(physics-informed 및 변형)·제조 공정 용어의 조합으로 문헌을 검색했다고 보고한다. 정확한 DB 목록, 검색식, 선별 수치와 표는 전문 fetch 403으로 확인하지 못했다.

sources.title: KAIST Research Portal bibliographic record for manufacturing PIML review
sources.description_ko: KAIST 기관 기록으로 6인 저자, 저널, 권·페이지, 2026년 및 DOI를 대조했다.

sources.title: NeurIPS official proceedings record: EngiBench
sources.description_ko: NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track의 공식 저자, 제목, DOI와 범위를 확인했다.

sources.title: ICLR official proceedings record: RealPDEBench
sources.description_ko: ICLR 2026 공식 저자·제목·학회 및 paired real/simulation benchmark abstract를 확인했다.

sources.title: arXiv full text: Domain Randomization for Object Detection in Manufacturing Applications using Synthetic Data
sources.description_ko: ICRA 2025 SynMfg 논문의 공개 전문에서 domain-randomization 구성, 세 제조 use case의 synthetic-only 학습/real-image 평가, mAP 결과 및 asset/access 한계를 표적 코딩했다. 독립 재현/인간 adjudication 아님.

sources.title: Official SynMfg repository environment.yml
sources.description_ko: 공식 environment.yml에서 Python 3.10.14, BlenderProc 2.7.1 및 bpy 4.0.0 pinned dependencies를 확인했다. README가 별도로 권하는 Blender 3.4.1과 실행 조합·재현성은 검증되지 않았다.

sources.title: DTU Orbit record and full-text access link: Synthetic data generation in manufacturing review
sources.description_ko: DTU 기관 기록은 2026 Procedia CIRP 논문(18편, 2024-01~2025-05), 최종본 445KB 및 CC BY를 명시한다. 직접 PDF와 기관 링크 클릭은 모두 HTTP 403을 반환했다. 논문 검색방법, 포함연구 표, 연구별 실행·물리·권리 자료는 확인하지 못했다.

sources.title: KAIST Research Portal record: Physics-informed machine learning across manufacturing processes
sources.description_ko: peer-reviewed JMS review의 5개 제조 process category와 governing physics/data regime/modeling objective 및 deployment 고려 범위를 기관 abstract에서 확인했다. publisher full-text fetch는 403, 따라서 세부 method table/repository/실행 범위는 코딩하지 않았다.

sources.title: NeurIPS 2025 official FuncGenFoil paper
sources.description_ko: NeurIPS 2025 FuncGenFoil은 항공 제조를 위한 함수공간 airfoil 생성·편집 모델이며 AF-200K 실험과 XFoil 기반 평가를 보고한다. 제조 설계 직접 연관 후보로 확인했으나 제조공정·현장 적격성 증거로 간주하지 않는다.

sources.title: Official FuncGenFoil author repository
sources.description_ko: 공개 Apache-2.0 코드, train/edit/evaluation scripts와 Gradio app 확인. README는 별도 Google Drive dataset을 받도록 안내한다. audited page에 pinned model release/checkpoint가 확인되지 않았으며 repository execution은 미수행.

sources.title: Official NeurIPS 2024 AF-200K dataset paper appendix
sources.description_ko: Appendix A는 AF-200K를 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 비상업 연구용으로 명시하고, 원천 UIUC data GPL, NACA MIT를 구분하며 XFoil aerodynamic labels가 relatively coarse라고 밝힌다. 관련 자산 권리는 항목별 검토가 필요하다.

sources.title: NeurIPS 2025 official CAD-Coder paper
sources.description_ko: CAD-Coder는 text-to-CAD 생성과 공개 code/model/data 링크를 제공하는 인접 CAD 설계 후보로 분리한다. CAD geometry generation은 제조 공정 합성데이터와 같은 층으로 집계하지 않는다.

sources.title: Official CAD-Coder author repository
sources.description_ko: 저장소 README는 Apache-2.0, inference code와 Hugging Face model/dataset 링크를 안내한다. 실제 고정 revision, weight/data license, cold-start resource, geometric/physical and manufacturing qualification은 미감사/미실행.

sources.title: ICCV 2021 official DeepCAD paper proceedings
sources.description_ko: DeepCAD는 CAD sequence로부터 3D CAD 형상을 생성하는 인접 설계연구다. manufacturing synthetic observation/process data와 구별해 CAD geometry stratum 후보로 둔다.

sources.title: Official DeepCAD author repository
sources.description_ko: MIT repository는 train/test/evaluation, pretrained weights download, STEP export 경로를 제공한다. README의 Onshape modeling sequence script는 TBA이며 오래된 CUDA/Python/OCC dependency와 third-party data rights를 cold-start 및 상업사용 평가에서 별도 확인해야 한다.

sources.title: CVPR 2025 official CADCrafter paper
sources.description_ko: CADCrafter는 실세계 이미지를 parametric CAD로 역변환하고 synthetic CAD render를 학습에 사용한다. 생성형 제조 데이터와 직접 혼합하지 않고 digital-twin/reverse-CAD 경계후보로 보류한다.

sources.title: CVPR 2025 official CADCrafter proceedings page
sources.description_ko: CADCrafter는 합성 textureless CAD data로 학습하고 실제 이미지로 평가하는 image-to-parametric-CAD digital twin 연구로, 제조·설계·시뮬레이션 동기를 밝힌다. CAD reverse-engineering 인접층으로 분류하며 공정 데이터 합성 포함 여부는 독립 심사 전이다.

sources.title: 3DID NeurIPS 2025 official proceedings abstract
sources.description_ko: Official NeurIPS main-conference record. Physics-geometry latent representation, gradient-guided diffusion, topology-preserving refinement for aerodynamic inverse design.

sources.title: 3DID NeurIPS 2025 official conference paper PDF
sources.description_ko: Official proceedings paper. Targeted indexed text review of dataset and implementation details; reports 8,085 DrivAerNet++ car designs and four NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPUs for model training; candidate outputs are also assessed with high-fidelity CFD.

sources.title: DrivAerNet++ NeurIPS 2024 official proceedings abstract
sources.description_ko: Official NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks record: 8,000 car designs with CFD simulations and public dataset/code link.

sources.title: DrivAerNet author repository README and dataset rights notice
sources.description_ko: Repository documents 39 TB DrivAerNet++ dataset under CC BY-NC 4.0, commercial use prohibited in current notice; code license MIT and commercial licensing inquiry route. This is dataset provenance, not 3DID generator code.

sources.title: CAD-Editor ICML 2025 PMLR paper
sources.description_ko: ICML 2025 paper on automated training-data synthesis for text-based CAD editing using geometry variations and LVLM-generated edit instructions.

sources.title: Microsoft CAD-Editor public repository and README
sources.description_ko: MIT repository was archived read-only on 2026-09-16. Documents a CAD variation and instruction-synthesis pipeline, processed data, two-stage inference, and external OpenAI endpoint configuration for image captions.

sources.title: Microsoft CAD-Editor Hugging Face model card and weights
sources.description_ko: Public model card labels weights MIT and links checkpoints/inference instructions; says research/experimental use and does not recommend commercial or real-world deployment without extra testing; base is Meta Llama-3-8B-Instruct and data derives from DeepCAD/SkexGen.

sources.title: CADFusion ICML 2025 PMLR paper
sources.description_ko: ICML 2025 text-to-CAD method alternating sequential learning and visual feedback; evaluations concern CAD generation quality rather than manufacturing process physics.

sources.title: Microsoft CADFusion public repository and README
sources.description_ko: MIT repository exposes training/data preparation and sample generation instructions; README lists Python 3.9 and pythonocc-core for rendering/evaluation, with downloadable model and data dependencies.

sources.title: Microsoft CADFusion Hugging Face model card and weights
sources.description_ko: Public model card labels weights MIT, links model checkpoints and generate_samples.sh; marks research/experimental use and advises against commercial/real-world deployment without further testing; base Llama-3-8B and DeepCAD/SkexGen data.

sources.title: CAD-Coder: NeurIPS 2025 official proceedings record
sources.description_ko: NeurIPS 2025 메인 컨퍼런스 논문은 text-to-CadQuery를 SFT와 Chamfer/format reward 기반 GRPO로 다루고 110K text-CadQuery-3D triplets 및 1.5K CoT samples를 보고한다. 기하 생성 결과이지 제조 공정 물리 증거는 아니다.

sources.title: CAD-Coder author repository and inference entrypoints
sources.description_ko: 저자 공개 저장소는 Apache-2.0을 표기하고 Transformers 추론, inference.py/batch_inference.py, Python 3.10 및 선택적 CadQuery 2.3.1 코드 실행을 안내한다. 코드 실행 시 생성 파이썬을 exec하는 예제가 있어 격리환경 검토가 필요하며 이번 감사에서 실행하지 않았다.

sources.title: CAD-Coder Hugging Face model card and checkpoint
sources.description_ko: 모델카드는 Apache-2.0 표기, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 기반, 8B BF16, Transformers 추론 예제 및 8x A800 80GB 학습을 보고한다. 학습 자산·출력물의 상업 목적별 권리는 별도 확인 대상이다.

sources.title: CAD-Coder Hugging Face dataset card
sources.description_ko: 데이터 카드는 Apache-2.0 표기, 전체 250,031 file-level rows, 파일별 train/validation/test 구성 및 Text2CAD 기반 합성 파생임을 밝힌다. 논문의 110K triplets/1.5K CoT와 사용 단계·단위·revision 조정 필요; 업스트림 자산 및 목적별 상업 권리는 별도 감사 대상이다.

sources.title: CAD-GPT AAAI 2025 official proceedings abstract
sources.description_ko: AAAI proceedings 초록은 이미지 또는 텍스트 입력으로 CAD construction sequence를 합성하고 3D 공간 추론을 개선한다고 설명한다. 제조 process data/physics 또는 physical metrology는 초록에 보고되지 않아 scope-boundary 후보로 유지한다.

sources.title: CAD-GPT author GitHub repository and current file listing
sources.description_ko: 저자 GitHub 저장소의 현재 표시 파일은 README와 assets 등이며 추론 코드/가중치는 확인되지 않았다. README의 2025-06-13 공지는 일부 데이터와 처리 코드를 이후 공개하겠다고 한다. 저장소 공개 링크는 즉시 실행 가능성의 증거가 아니다.

sources.title: CAD-GPT author project page
sources.description_ko: 저자 프로젝트 페이지는 Code (Coming Soon!)으로 표시하며, 저자 설명상 DeepCAD 기반으로 160k fixed-viewpoint CAD images와 18k natural-language captions를 구축하고 image-CAD 후 text-CAD의 2단계 학습을 설명한다. 이는 저자 설명이며 독립 실행/검증이 아니다.

sources.title: CAD-GPT Hugging Face dataset card
sources.description_ko: Hugging Face dataset page shows MIT license metadata, but reports that the dataset is currently empty and README content is empty. This is not an obtainable training dataset release.

sources.title: CADCrafter CVPR 2025 official proceedings page and abstract
sources.description_ko: CVPR 공식 페이지는 image-to-parametric-CAD framework가 합성 textureless CAD data로 학습되고 real-world image에 적용됨을 보고한다. CAD 기하/command 평가이며 제조공정 physics나 제조 데이터 자체의 합성을 입증하지 않는다.

sources.title: CADCrafter CVPR 2025 official full paper PDF
sources.description_ko: 공식 PDF 검색 가능한 전문은 기하 encoder, DPO CAD code checker, RealCAD형 multi-view 이미지/CAD command validation dataset, 3D-printed CAD model imagery를 언급한다. 향후 물리특성 통합을 제안하며 본 논문은 공정 물리·metrology를 제공하지 않는다. 전면 full-text coding은 미완료.

sources.title: ICML 2025 official proceedings page and abstract: Open Materials Generation with Stochastic Interpolants
sources.description_ko: PMLR 공식 초록은 OMatG의 무기 결정 구조 생성, 결정 대칭·주기 경계 고려, crystal structure prediction 및 de novo generation을 설명한다. 제조 공정 데이터나 실험 합성/공장 검증 근거와는 구별한다.

sources.title: FERMat-ML author repository README: OMatG code and generation instructions
sources.description_ko: 저자 저장소는 MIT 라이선스, Python 3.11-3.13, PyTorch 2.8 및 PyG 의존성, omg predict generation 명령, 설정 파일과 checkpoint 링크를 문서화한다. 고정 revision의 clean-start 실행은 아직 수행하지 않았다.

sources.title: FERMat-ML OMatG repository MIT license
sources.description_ko: 저자 코드 저장소의 LICENSE 파일은 MIT 조건을 표시한다. 이 라이선스가 upstream 학습데이터, 소재 구조, 모델 산출물이나 특정 산업 용도의 규제/제품 적격성까지 자동 승인하지는 않는다.

sources.title: OMatG MP-20-DNG Hugging Face model card and checkpoint listing
sources.description_ko: 저자 조직 모델 카드는 MP-20 데이터로 학습한 de novo 무기결정 생성 모델, checkpoint/config 사용 경로와 MIT license metadata를 제공한다. 실제 checkpoint 다운로드·고정·추론은 이 조사에서 실행하지 않았다.

sources.title: OMatG Alex-MP-20 Hugging Face dataset card and license metadata
sources.description_ko: 동일 저자 조직의 Alex-MP-20 데이터 카드에는 CC BY 4.0 metadata와 약 540k train rows/675k 전체 규모 표시가 있다. 이는 OMatG-DNG 학습 MP-20의 권리 대체 확인이 아니며, 각 학습 데이터 계보 및 실제 상업 사용조건은 별도 검토가 필요하다.

sources.title: NeurIPS 2025 official proceedings record and abstract: LLM Meets Diffusion: A Hybrid Framework for Crystal Material Generation
sources.description_ko: NeurIPS 2025 Main Conference 공식 기록은 CrysLLMGen을 LLM+equivariant diffusion 기반 결정 재료 생성으로 설명하고 저자 코드 저장소를 연결한다. 생성 대상은 제조 공정 관측값이 아니라 주기적 결정 구조다.

sources.title: CrysLLMGen author GitHub repository and README: training, inference, dependency and checkpoint instructions
sources.description_ko: 저자 저장소는 MIT 라이선스 metadata와 Python 코드를 공개한다. README는 requirements가 pipreqs로 생성돼 추가 누락 의존성이 있을 수 있다고 밝힌다. sampling은 로컬 fine-tuned LLaMA-2 checkpoint 및 diffusion checkpoint 경로를 요구하고 앞선 단계로 LLM fine-tuning과 diffusion 500 epoch 학습을 안내한다. 검토한 저장소 파일 목록에서 배포된 추론 checkpoint를 확인하지 못했다.

sources.title: CrysLLMGen author repository LICENSE and model file inventory
sources.description_ko: GitHub 저장소의 license metadata는 MIT이며 models_ddpm 목록은 모델 구현 소스 파일을 보여준다. 평가 당시 확인한 목록에 가중치 파일이나 공개 releases가 없었다. 이 부재 관찰은 해당 저장소 경로와 확인 시점의 범위에 한정한다.

sources.title: HUST-SLOW SeaS official README: code release, environment, training/inference checkpoints, outputs and license
sources.description_ko: 저자 README는 완전한 코드와 생성 image-mask/normal 데이터 공개를 알리고 Python 3.9, CUDA 11.8, PyTorch 2.2.1 환경을 제시한다. 추론은 별도 생성 모델 및 RMP mask checkpoint가 필요하며 README에는 이를 먼저 학습하는 절차가 나온다. MIT LICENSE와 함께 README는 상업 라이선스 문의도 안내한다.

sources.title: HUST-SLOW SeaS Hugging Face generated image-mask and normal-image dataset listing
sources.description_ko: 저자 조직의 공개 dataset listing은 MIT metadata를 표시하지만 파일을 받으려면 연락처 정보 공유 동의가 필요하다. 검사 시 anomaly image zip 12.2/25.9/28.1 GB, normal image zip 3.17/5.02/4.48 GB로 표시된다. 이는 generated examples이지 SeaS 추론 checkpoint의 증거가 아니다.

sources.title: MVTec AD official benchmark data and license terms
sources.description_ko: MVTec 공식 페이지는 산업검사 anomaly benchmark의 15개 object/texture category와 pixel-level masks를 설명하고 데이터 사용조건으로 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 및 비상업적 이용을 명시한다. 이는 SeaS 소프트웨어 MIT와 별도로 평가해야 한다.

sources.title: CompVis Stable Diffusion v1-4 official model card and CreativeML OpenRAIL-M license
sources.description_ko: SeaS README가 요구하는 Stable Diffusion v1.4 base weights는 CompVis 모델 카드에서 CreativeML OpenRAIL-M으로 식별된다. 이 upstream model/license chain은 SeaS code의 MIT 표시와 분리해 검토한다.

sources.title: Few-shot Defect Image Generation based on Consistency Modeling (ECCV 2024 official paper)
sources.description_ko: ECCV 공식 논문. DefectDiffu 방법, MVTec AD 평가, 실험 split 및 논문이 공개한다고 밝힌 코드 링크를 확인.

sources.title: Few-shot Defect Image Generation based on Consistency Modeling supplementary material
sources.description_ko: ECCV 공식 부록 링크는 확인했으나 직접 열람은 payload size limit으로 차단됨. Supplement 내용은 검토 근거로 사용하지 않음.

sources.title: FFDD-diffusion/DefectDiffu official repository README and inference script
sources.description_ko: 공식 README, 연결된 pretrained DiT/VAE 및 train/test 진입점을 확인. test.py는 별도 fine-tuned checkpoint 입력을 요구한다. bounded root inventory에서 특정 DefectDiffu inference checkpoint와 license file/표시는 검증하지 못했다; 전역 부재를 단정하지 않음.

sources.title: AnyDoor exact 16.8 GB checkpoint file at Hugging Face Space revision 049b1c6
sources.description_ko: TF-IDG README가 연결하는 xichenhku/AnyDoor Space의 정확한 파일 페이지를 확인. revision 049b1c6, 16.8 GB, SHA-256 89be5db3ca8d07dab4d525b7c8d40e12f80c6a45f8fce769d5617640d2f36ec0. 공개 다운로드 경로와 무결성 지문을 확인했으나 파일 다운로드/로드 및 checkpoint-specific license 판정은 하지 않음. Space code/model metadata를 가중치 권리로 자동 확장하지 않음.

sources.title: AnyDoor official repository LICENSE and pretrained-checkpoint release instructions
sources.description_ko: 공식 AnyDoor 저장소는 LICENSE.txt MIT와 pretrained checkpoint release를 알린다. README는 checkpoint가 optimizer parameters를 포함해 크며 state_dict만 남기면 작아질 수 있다고 설명한다. 이는 wrapper 코드·특정 mirrored weight·산출물·3rd party dataset의 이용권을 한꺼번에 확정하지 않음.

sources.title: DINOv2 official model card, Apache 2.0 license, and ViT-g/14 pretrained backbone link
sources.description_ko: DINOv2 공식 model card는 모델 라이선스를 Apache 2.0으로 표시하고 ViT-g/14 pretrained backbone과 공개 download/hub 경로를 제공한다. TF-IDG에서 이를 소비하는 실행 호환성/weight hash는 아직 미검증.

sources.title: ICML 2025 official PMLR proceedings page and abstract for PEINR
sources.description_ko: Official PMLR page describes PEINR as physics-enhanced flow-field reconstruction and reports the 5.4 TB HFR-Beach dataset with 33,600 unsteady 2D/3D vector fields. The abstract frames reconstruction/resolution enhancement, not manufacturing-process synthetic observations or a manufacturing transfer study.

sources.title: PEINR author-linked public GitHub repository and README
sources.description_ko: Repository lists PyTorch code and train/inference commands, with 3DMix and RT/DM simulation data linked through external file hosts. A pinned commit, task checkpoint access, license chain and clean-start run were not verified in this screening follow-up.

sources.title: ICLR 2025 official proceedings page and abstract for VLMaterial
sources.description_ko: Official abstract describes image-conditioned procedural material appearance generation as Python programs for graphics node graphs and an open procedural material dataset. No manufacturing process, product/material property synthesis, or physical validator is described in the abstract. No release or license audit performed in this screening recovery.

sources.title: NeurIPS 2024 official proceedings abstract: Infusing Synthetic Data with Real-World Patterns for Zero-Shot Material State Segmentation
sources.description_ko: Abstract describes injecting real-image material patterns into synthetic scenes and a zero-shot material-state benchmark. Abstract is not evidence of manufacturing process physics or industrial qualification.

sources.title: Author project page: Infusing Synthetic Data with Real-World Patterns
sources.description_ko: Links benchmark, 2D/3D data-generation code, texture-extraction code and trained network. Links identify assets; they do not prove cold-start or asset rights.

sources.title: Official 2D generation repository: MatSeg2D-generation-code
sources.description_ko: Repository metadata shows CC0-1.0; README describes CPU generation and sample scripts. Local execution was blocked before fetch; dependency stack and assets were not independently tested.

sources.title: Official trained network repository: Zero-Shot-Material-State-Segmentation-Net
sources.description_ko: Repository presents model code and external weight links and CC0 metadata; model archive license/coverage and exact hash were not independently verified. README says training used RTX 3090.

sources.title: Zenodo MatSeg dataset current version record 1
sources.description_ko: Record reports 100,000 synthetic images and 1,220 real benchmark images; record-level CC0 label coexists with upstream OpenImages and ShapeNet source assets whose terms require separate audit. Older record reports 820 benchmark images; reconcile release versions before use.

sources.title: Zenodo MatSeg trained code, network weights and evaluation scripts release
sources.description_ko: Archive is 508.5 MB, MD5 3e5fe4c54e74bcfb4dea23de5b459937; Zenodo record Rights/License field is blank. No download or inference run performed.

sources.title: MatFuse: Controllable Material Generation with Diffusion Models
sources.description_ko: Graphics-focused generation/editing of SVBRDF maps from color palettes, sketches, text, and images; evaluations use CLIP-IQA/FID and a user study. No manufacturing-process data or process-physics validation is established by the abstract.

sources.title: MaterialMVP: Illumination-Invariant Material Generation via Multi-view PBR Diffusion
sources.description_ko: Generates PBR textures from 3D meshes and image prompts; tests multi-view and illumination consistency for 3D asset creation. Visual/PBR realism does not establish manufacturing material-property or process validation.

sources.title: A Periodic Bayesian Flow for Material Generation
sources.description_ko: CrysBFN generates periodic crystal structures and evaluates ab initio generation and structure prediction, reporting sampling-step efficiency on MP-20. Crystal/material design is adjacent to manufacturing but not manufacturing-process data generation or field qualification.

sources.title: FlowLLM: Flow Matching for Material Generation with Large Language Models as Base Distributions
sources.description_ko: Combines a language-model crystal base distribution and Riemannian flow matching to generate crystalline materials, evaluating structural stability/novelty and relaxed-state proximity. This is materials discovery rather than manufacturing-process synthetic data; retain as an H2 transfer boundary.

sources.title: A Unified Anomaly Synthesis Strategy with Gradient Ascent for Industrial Anomaly Detection and Localization — ECCV 2024 full paper
sources.description_ko: Official ECCV paper PDF. GLASS combines feature-space global anomaly synthesis and image-space local anomaly synthesis; reported image benchmarks include a self-built woven-fabric dataset with data partly sourced from production sites. No process-governing physics or independent factory-operation validation identified in assessed sections.

sources.title: GLASS ECCV 2024 supplementary material
sources.description_ko: Official supplement Appendix A.2 describes WFDD split: 3,657 normal training, 203 normal and 241 anomaly test images; three categories collected at WEIQIAO production sites and one from a public Cloth Flaw dataset. Reported WFDD average image/pixel AUROC is 100/98.9 for GLASS-j. This is offline held-out dataset performance, not M3 field operation.

sources.title: Few-Shot Defect Image Generation via Defect-Aware Feature Manipulation — AAAI 2023 official full paper
sources.description_ko: AAAI 공식 논문 전문. DFMGAN은 StyleGAN2 정상 이미지 사전학습 뒤 결함 인지 residual block과 mask를 소수 결함 이미지로 학습한다. MVTec AD 벤치마크 KID/LPIPS와 소규모 downstream classification을 보고한다. process physics나 외부 현장검증은 확인되지 않았다.

sources.title: DFMGAN author repository and README
sources.description_ko: AAAI 공식 논문이 연결하는 저자 저장소. README는 Google Drive hazelnut good/defect checkpoint, generation command와 mask 옵션을 제시한다. immutable commit/file hash, checkpoint 사용권, clean-start 실행은 검증하지 않았다.

sources.title: DFMGAN repository LICENSE.txt — NVIDIA Source Code License
sources.description_ko: DFMGAN 저장소 LICENSE.txt는 NVIDIA Source Code License를 담고 section 3.3은 Work와 derivative works를 비상업 research/evaluation only로 제한한다. checkpoint, output, MVTec 및 모든 third-party component 권리는 별도 검토 대상이다.

sources.title: Text-Guided Variational Image Generation for Industrial Anomaly Detection and Segmentation — CVPR 2024 official paper
sources.description_ko: CVPR 공식 논문 PDF searchable full text와 저자 arXiv v2 전체 HTML(본문+부록)을 표적 열람. 정상 reference image 증강용 WordNet/CLIP prompt selection, variance-aware VQGAN generation 및 4 detector×3 dataset 평가를 확인했다. 체계적 독립 전문 코딩은 아니다.

sources.title: Text-Guided Variational Image Generation — CVPR 2024 official supplement
sources.description_ko: CVPR 공식 supplement URL의 검색 색인에서 구현·prompt·연산자원·반복실험 발췌를 표적 확인. PDF 파일 전체를 다운로드하거나 시각 검토하지 않아 발췌 밖 세부사항은 미확인.

sources.description_ko: CVPR 2025 공식 논문 페이지: 소수 결함 참조로 inpainting diffusion을 fine-tune하고 defect/object/attention loss 및 Low-Fidelity Selection으로 결함 이미지를 합성해 MVTec AD 시각검사 결과를 보고한다. 웹 도구 직접 페이지 접근은 403이어서 게시자 색인 발췌를 사용했으며 전체 PDF 전문 코딩으로 간주하지 않는다.
